home.title: HEC Reporting System
home.tagline: Report human-elephant conflict incidents and track your compensation claims
home.heroBody: Register your claim and get a receipt instantly.
home.checkStatusSub: Look up a claim by its reference number
home.infoStrip: You can submit a report without a network connection. A field officer can also register one on your behalf.

offline.banner: You are offline. Reports will be saved and sent when you reconnect.

gate.title: Register your family first
gate.body: Before you can report an incident, one person from your family needs to be registered. It only takes a few minutes, and you only do it once.

step1.title: Reporting for your family
step1.saveError: Couldn’t save your details. Please try again.
step1.intro: This report is filed for your registered family, so you don't need to enter your NIC or phone number again.

step2.title: Incident location
step2.gpsFailed: We couldn’t detect your location. Place a pin on the map instead.
step2.saveError: Couldn’t save the location. Please try again.

step4.title: Add Photos
step4.saveError: Couldn’t save the photo. Please try again.
step4.readError: Couldn’t read that image. Please choose a different photo.

step1.title: Register your family
step1.intro: Only one person from each family registers. Start with your own ID number.
step1.nicError: Enter a valid NIC number (9 digits and V, or 12 digits).

step2.title: Who is in your family?
step2.intro: Add the people who live in your household.
step2.why: Only one person from a family registers. This is so your family is not paid twice for the same incident.
step2.nicError: One of the NIC numbers is not valid.
step2.duplicateError: The same NIC number is listed twice.

step3.title: Where do you live?
step3.intro: This decides which officers and which Divisional Secretariat office handle your claims.
step3.areaError: Please select your district and division.

step4.title: Bank account (optional)
step4.intro: If you give an account, the Divisional Secretariat can pay compensation into it directly.
step4.optional: You can skip this. The Divisional Secretariat office can add your account later.
step4.contactEmailHint: We will email you when your claim status changes. You can leave this blank.

error.alreadyRegistered: You have already registered a household.

conflict.titleYou: You have already registered your family
conflict.why: Only one person from each family registers, so your family is not paid twice for the same loss.
conflict.whatToDo: Talk to the Divisional Secretariat office to be added to your family registration — or to move it to your name if the registered person has died.

done.label: Your family is registered
done.body: Keep this number. You can now report an incident.

register.privacyNic: Your ID number is turned into a code the moment it reaches us. The number itself is never stored.
register.privacyBank: Your account number is encrypted. It can be read only by the Divisional Secretariat, at the moment it releases your payment.

poc.title: Proof of Claim
poc.offlineNotice: Your report will sync when you reconnect. Keep this QR code as evidence.
poc.successBody: Keep this receipt for your records.
poc.qrHint: Scan this QR code to verify your claim or check its status at any DWC office.
poc.screenshotHint: Tap Share or take a screenshot to save this receipt.
poc.reminder: A DWC officer will contact you. You can check your claim's progress using {ref}.
poc.temporaryHint: Your HEC reference number appears in My Claims once this report reaches the server.

status.title: Check Claim Status
status.notFound: Reference not found. Check the number on your Proof of Claim.
status.serviceError: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
status.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera access denied. Please type your reference instead.
status.intro: Enter the reference number printed on your Proof of Claim. You do not need an account.
status.emptyBody: Enter your reference number above, or scan the QR code on your Proof of Claim.

nextStep.Submitted: Your report has been received. A wildlife officer will assess the damage.
nextStep.UnderReview: An officer is assessing your claim. No action is needed from you.
nextStep.Approved: Your claim has been approved. The Divisional Secretariat will release payment to your registered bank account.
nextStep.Rejected: This claim was not approved. Your Divisional Secretariat office can explain the decision.
nextStep.PaymentProcessed: Payment has been released to your registered bank account.

stageNext.submitted: Your report has been received. A wildlife officer for your area will review it.
stageNext.officer_review: A wildlife officer is reviewing your report. No action is needed from you.
stageNext.officer_assessed: The officer has assessed the damage. The DWC office is reviewing the assessment.
stageNext.dwc_approved: Approved by DWC. The Divisional Secretariat is reviewing the final compensation amount.
stageNext.ds_final_decided: The Divisional Secretariat has confirmed your final compensation amount. Payment will be released to your registered bank account.
stageNext.payment_processed: The Divisional Secretariat has authorised the payment to your registered bank account.
stageNext.rejected: This claim was not approved. Your Divisional Secretariat office can explain the decision.
